phases.label: J Space Vestibule

phases.label: Ringed Moon Arrival
phases.purpose: Present Terra Aeterna's unmistakable arrival signature.
phases.transition: Open into full spatial field without a volume jump.

phases.label: Hearthweave Immersion
phases.purpose: Support imaginative inhabitation and creative work.
phases.transition: After the first five minutes, reduce conspicuous modulation unless manually retained.

phases.label: Hearthward Return
phases.purpose: Withdraw world layers in a stable order and restore ordinary orientation.
phases.transition: Haptics and spatial motion stop first; triad resolves to root; ocean remains briefly, then fades.
